# HOI4 Portrait Workflows 1.0.1

This patch release updates the portrait crop, batch seed, and public documentation.

## Changes

- The batch workflow now defaults to seed `757254001619850`.
- **Face zoom** now defaults to `1.00`, frames the face slightly larger, and removes a little more torso while preserving detected hair and headwear.
- Crop-only tests verify the closer automatic framing.
- The README introduction, workflow overview, and RunPod referral note are more concise.

## Downloads

- **Model-free ZIP** — workflows, guides, installers, custom nodes, and bundled assets.
- **Windows x64 installer** — detects the GPU, recommends a model variant, and installs the complete workflow package.
- **RunPod runtime archive** — installs the workflows and dependencies on an existing ComfyUI pod.

> **Starting on RunPod? [Use my referral link](https://runpod.io/?ref=9t44ghaf) when creating a new account. You get $5 free once you add $10.**

See [Getting started](https://github.com/klimPaskov/comfyui-hoi4-portraits/blob/v1.0.1/docs/getting-started.md) for installation and first-run instructions.
